 Follow Chris Pratt Reveals How Long Prime Video’s The Terminal List Could Last, Teases Spin-off Shows
 Mintu Kumar Tomar Thu, October 22, 2026 at 7:33 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Photo Credit: Amazon Prime Video Chris Pratt has teased an extended future of his Prime Video TV show The Terminal List . The show is based on Jack Carr's bestselling eight-book series of the same name, with Season 2 adapting the second novel, True Believer.
 In an exclusive interview with ComingSoon's Tyler Treese, Pratt discussed his long-term vision for staying with the character of Lieutenant Commander James Reece. Asked whether the series intends to adapt the remainder of Carr's extensive book catalog, the actor said, "Yeah, I want it to. James Reece's last mission is going to be he's going to eat a steak without his dentures in. Sorry, Amazon, this is for life."
 Pratt then teased multiple spin-off projects based on James Reece's dynamics with other characters. He mentioned "Cry Havoc, which is a really great story. We love that. We had Dark Wolf. I think there's a lot of these supporting characters that deserve their own stories. I'm super curious about the Hastings family and their ranch. We're constantly dreaming up ideas."
 What happens in The Terminal List Season 2 with Chris Pratt?
 The Terminal List Season 2 sees Chris Pratt's James Reece going on a globe-trotting mission from Langley to Moscow. After living in isolation, Reece gets called for a new mission following the attacks in London by a new terrorist organization.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement According to an official description, the second chapter follows Reece's redemption journey. He tries to find "a new purpose after finishing his list. He will uncover a conspiracy that reaches from Moscow to Langley, with ties into his own family's history."
 Season 2's ensemble cast also features Tom Hopper as Raife Hastings, Constance Wu as Katie Buranek, Dar Salim as Mohammed Farooq, and Luke Hemsworth as Jules Landry. They are joined by Gabriel Luna as Freddy Strain, alongside Costa Ronin, Olga Kurylenko, Yul Vazquez, Arnold Vosloo, Martin Sensmeier, Shiraz Tzarfati, and Jeremy Bobb.
 The show is produced by Amazon MGM Studios, MRC, and Civic Center Media. All eight episodes of The Terminal List Season 2 are now streaming on Prime Video .
 Originally reported on ComingSoon .
